# thousandeyes_connectors_panorama (Resource)

Retrieve Panorama connector.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Code generated by tfpfgen. DO NOT EDIT.

resource "thousandeyes_connectors_panorama" "example" {
  name   = "tfacc-name"
  target = "tfacc-target"
  type   = "tfacc-type"
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the Panorama connector.
- `target` (String) URL of the Panorama instance.
- `type` (String) Connector type.

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Unique ID of the Panorama connector.
- `last_modified_date` (Number) Time when the connector was last modified, in milliseconds since the Unix epoch.
